project_type: Full-stack web app: React/TypeScript frontend (Vite + TanStack Router) with .NET 8 C# Web API backend
build_system: Bun for frontend (package.json scripts), dotnet for backend. Backend targets net8.0-windows and CANNOT be built in this sandbox.
test_framework: No test runner configured for frontend (no test script in package.json). Backend has no visible test project.
build_command: cd src/Nexus.Frontend && bun install && bun run build
test_command: cd src/Nexus.Frontend && bun run build (TypeScript compilation is the validation)
verification_instructions: 1. Run bun install in src/Nexus.Frontend. 2. Run bun run build to verify TypeScript compiles. 3. Backend .cs files validated by syntax/pattern review only (cannot build net8.0-windows on Linux).
environment_constraints: Backend targets net8.0-windows - cannot be compiled in this Linux sandbox. Only make code changes to backend, validate via AST/pattern consistency. Frontend can be built with bun.
contribution_requirements: File-based routing (TanStack Router). API client functions in src/Nexus.Frontend/src/api/client.ts. Controllers in src/Nexus.Gateway/Controllers/. Services in src/Nexus.Gateway/Services/. Models in src/Nexus.Gateway/Models/. SignalR already configured at /hub/notifications.
key_patterns: Frontend: React functional components, useState/useEffect hooks, lucide-react icons, sonner toasts, NxCard/PageWrapper layout components, ServerSelector for server context. Backend: ASP.NET Core controllers with [Authorize], EF Core for data, PowerShell execution via IPowerShellExecutionService, SignalR hub at /hub/notifications, NotificationService broadcasts via IHubContext.
directory_structure: Root: src/Nexus.Frontend (React app), src/Nexus.Gateway (ASP.NET Core API), src/Nexus.Launcher, Packaging/. Frontend routes in src/Nexus.Frontend/src/routes/. Backend controllers in src/Nexus.Gateway/Controllers/. Backend services in src/Nexus.Gateway/Services/. Models in src/Nexus.Gateway/Models/. DB context in src/Nexus.Gateway/Data/.
